## v0.3.0 — Shippable camera support, multi-sensor enrollment & network survey

This release turns camera support into **installable, signed data** that can grow without an app update, rounds out enrollment for multi-sensor and specialized cameras, and adds a one-click **network survey** that reports exactly which cameras on a subnet are supported.

### What's new

- **Camera support as installable packs** — Support for new camera models now ships as a signed *support pack* (data, not code). Installing a pack takes effect immediately — no application restart — so newly tested cameras become enrollable without waiting for a release.
- **Online pack catalog + "pending device support" queue** — The system can check a signed online catalog for new support packs and install them in one click (fully optional and air-gap-safe — offline systems simply skip it). Cameras the wizard can't yet fully support are added to a pending-support queue that auto-clears when a matching pack arrives.
- **Camera "personalities"** — Cameras running a specialized on-camera AI app (for example a factory & safety app that detects *Person + Forklift*) are now recognized and configured with the right object vocabulary automatically, labeled by their role.
- **Multi-sensor cameras** — Multi-lens cameras (e.g. multi-directional / multi-sensor models) now have **every sensor configured**, not just the first channel. Each lens is read and configured against its own capability.
- **Smarter zone takeover** — Adopting a camera's existing zones now suggests a role for each zone from its name (editable), so taking over a pre-configured camera lands closer to ready.
- **Warehouse & logistics analytics** — New Forklift and Vehicle activity tiles and a Logistics/Warehouse dashboard template surface object-class activity alongside the existing people-centric metrics.
- **Network survey** — A new **Survey network** page scans a private subnet, identifies every camera, and reports support coverage at a glance (verified / supported / refused / unidentified) with model, firmware, and analytics path per device. Export the report as CSV or JSON — ideal for site audits and pre-deployment planning.

### Notes
- Standard single-sensor cameras enroll exactly as before; the new behavior applies only where it's relevant (multi-sensor hardware, app-specific cameras, takeover).
- The online pack catalog is optional and never degrades an offline or air-gapped install — it fails closed and quietly.
- No configuration changes are required after upgrading.
